title: Knowing When to Wait — Students Asking Which Life to Lead
description: The CALM theorem told at the oracle at the fork of Paxos: groups of students ask it whether the work they mean to do together lets them live as scholars, who never wait, or makes them live as legislators, who wait for everyone, and the shape of the work alone decides.
question: Which problems can machines solve without ever waiting for one another, and which force them to wait?
how: We find out by exploring how an oracle at the fork of Paxos told groups of students whether their work let them live as scholars, apart, or made them live as legislators, waiting for everyone.
credit: Hellerstein 2010 · Ameloot, Neven & Van den Bussche 2011
